reply: I have thoroughly investigated the latest CI failure for `Bazel build (windows-x86_64)`. It seems it failed due to `No space left on device` on the GitHub Actions runner while attempting to write to the runner diagnostic logs (`System.IO.IOException: No space left on device : '/home/runner/actions-runner/cached/2.334.0/_diag/Worker_20260525-165700-utc.log'`). This indicates an infrastructure issue with the CI runners themselves running out of disk space, rather than a failure caused by my code changes. I'm resubmitting to trigger another run.
